correctness.rationale: The analytic proof normalizes the bounded-exponent Luxemburg modular, proves uniform tail modular bounds, and passes from tail subspaces to every finite-codimensional subspace via nonzero intersections. The scalar root is unique; comparing lambda^{-P} and lambda^{-1} with the normalized head modular gives respectively exact minimum/equality cases and strict pointwise nonattainment of the smoothness supremum. Coordinate-pair separation yields K=2. The packaged standalone checker reproduces finite analogues, but infinite claims do not rely on finite tests.

value.rationale: The natural all-scale AUC and AUS moduli are important to the geometry of the 2026 nonreflexive fixed-point examples. This is a complete exact classification, not a small numerical improvement: every point has equal pointwise moduli while infimum and supremum of those identical functions split sharply, governed by different exponent regimes. Complete convexity minimizers and smoothness nonattainment are determined, and the natural p_n=1+1/n example yields an exact golden-ratio endpoint.
